name: Convergence C / L / Li / A · Water
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning + 2.25 ❤ arcane (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Growth: up to 5 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 6 s
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 5.22 blocks with 39% health
• Puts out fire
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
• Knockback
